description: Connect to the viaim App to search and read recordings, transcripts and AI summaries, browse recently updated records, and turn them into meeting notes and action items.

display.description_en: Connect to the viaim App to search and read recordings, transcripts and AI summaries, browse recently updated records, and turn them into meeting notes and action items.
display.description_zh: 连接 viaim App，查询或按关键词搜索录音记录，读取转写内容与 AI 摘要，查看最近更新的记录，并整理会议纪要和待办事项。
examples_en: Read the AI summary of this recording and extract the key conclusions.
Read the transcript of this recording and turn it into meeting notes.
Extract action items from this recording. Mark any unspecified owner or deadline as unspecified.
examples_zh: 列出我最近的 viaim 录音记录。
查看这条录音的 AI 摘要，提取关键结论。
读取这条录音的转写内容，整理成会议纪要。
查看最近更新的录音记录。
根据这条录音的内容整理待办事项；没有明确负责人或截止时间的，请标注未明确。
